race.comment: Open race to close out the card. Former Victorian ESHA (6) wasn't too far away when having the first run for the Gollan yard and rider Thompson sticks in the stirrups. Drawn to get a soft run from the inside alley and can feature prominently with natural improvement. MOONHAVEN (1) is two from two over this course and distance and gets some weight off from the low draw. Plenty to like about his prospects. TIGER TIE (2) grows a leg for hoop Fenlon who has six wins and two placings from 14 steers. Top-three credentials. BIANCELLI (9) was a touch plain last time out but the form prior was good enough for a race of this nature. Worth another chance. MISS PERSONALITY (7) next in line while fresh.
